svg.text: Every byte the guest CPU and the host GPU share is host GPU memory, allocated on demand and exported as a dma-buf.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: QEMU maps it into the hostmem= BAR, which the guest maps with the host's own caching: no copies in between.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guest RAM is never handed to a host GPU, and the frames the desktop composes are scanned out zero-copy.
